HAITLANG 1: Course emphasizes developing effective communication at a basic level, with topics on personal information and activities necessary for basic survival. Grammatical structures, vocabulary, and sentence patterns through speaking, reading, writing, and listening. Haitian Creole culture.
HAITLANG 2: Course emphasizes developing effective communication at a basic level, with topics on personal information and activities necessary for basic survival. Grammatical structures, vocabulary, and sentence patterns through speaking, reading, writing, and listening. Haitian Creole culture. Prerequisite: HAITLANG 1 or placement test.
HAITLANG 3: Course emphasizes developing effective communication at a basic level, with topics on personal information and activities necessary for basic survival. Grammatical structures, vocabulary, and sentence patterns through speaking, reading, writing, and listening. Haitian Creole culture. Prerequisite: HAITLANG 2 or placement test. Completion of this course completes the Stanford Language requirement
HAITLANG 21: Continuation of HAITLANG 3. Expands students' proficiency in Haitian Creole language and culture through various texts and multimedia. Students will continue to learn the language with an emphasis on communicative and interactive classroom activities. Prerequisite: Placement Test or HAITLANG 3.
HAITLANG 22: Continuation of HAITLANG 21. Expands students' proficiency in Haitian Creole language and culture through various texts and multimedia. Students will continue to learn the language with an emphasis on communicative and interactive classroom activities. Prerequisite: Placement Test or HAITLANG 21.
HAITLANG 23: Continuation of HAITLANG 22. Expands students' proficiency in Haitian Creole language and culture through various texts and multimedia. Students will continue to learn the language with an emphasis on communicative and interactive classroom activities. Prerequisite: Placement Test or HAITLANG 22.
HAITLANG 395: Graduate studies in Haitian language. For grad students only
